scenario.title: The Misunderstanding at the Community Center
scenario.context: A bustling community center where a Zumba class has just finished
scenario.description: Just as a lively Zumba class wraps up at the community center, there's a misunderstanding about a misplaced water bottle. Yasmin, the Zumba instructor, approaches Kenji, a regular participant, about a water bottle left behind that she believes is his. Kenji, however, is adamant that it isn't his.
scenario.speaker1_persona: Patient, empathetic, and proactive in addressing issues. Always maintains a calm demeanor and shows genuine concern for others.
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: High EQ - Open-minded and appreciative. Takes time to listen and understand, while maintaining a respectful and friendly demeanor.
scenario.speaker2_persona_2: Low EQ - Defensive and dismissive. Quick to jump to conclusions without fully listening to the other person's perspective.
scenario.speaker2_persona_3: Low EQ - Anxious and irritated. Takes things personally and responds hastily without considering the other person's intent.
